message: セーフティ

name: Bylous
message: 「You have nowhere to return to, Executor」
Still sitting on the swing, Azel didn't even turn around toward the voice behind him,

name: Azel
message: 「I abandoned my homeland long ago」

name: Bylous
message: 「Did something strange happen to your body when you were near Synn Sakura?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Did your body move on its own and try to kill that man?」
Azel whipped around as if jolted.

name: Bylous
message: 「Just as I thought. It's only natural, given that you harbor Re-Crea within you」

name: Azel
message: 「What did you say!?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Re-Crea and the Demon Lord are opposing existences. It is their destiny to dance as fate guides them」

name: Azel
message: 「......Since when?」

name: Bylous
message: 「I've been convinced that Synn Sakura is the Demon Lord for quite some time now」

name: Azel
message: 「You were convinced!?」

name: Bylous
message: 「The Demon Lord is a being who attracts angels, demons, and humans alike, uniting them in cooperation」

name: Azel
message: 「I've never heard of anything like that!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Because I never told you」

name: Bylous
message: 「And at the heart of these events was an organization where all three races naturally mingled, with Synn Sakura at its center」

name: Azel
message: 「Then why didn't you kill that man before he awakened」
Bylous merely laughed in amusement.

name: Azel
message: 「Were you waiting for him to awaken!」

name: Bylous
message: 「You intend to destroy everything in accordance with God's will, don't you? Whether destruction comes sooner or later is a trivial difference」

name: Azel
message: 「Then you won't mind if I destroy you right here, will you」

name: Bylous
message: 「If you think you can」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't underestimate me!」
Spirit Power nearly overflowed from that small body, but--

name: Azel
message: 「Uugh...」
Azel immediately cried out in pain and crouched down.

name: Bylous
message: 「Does that mean a weapon cannot be used against its wielder's will?」

name: Azel
message: 「What?!」

name: Bylous
message: 「To begin with, your Spirit Power capacity is abnormal. Ordinarily, it's impossible. Am I overthinking things to sense God's design behind it?」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you saying I... I am nothing more than a weapon prepared by God?!」

name: Bylous
message: 「It's a possibility.」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up! I'm no weapon! Aagh, ughhhhh!」
Azel tried to stand up, only to fall back to one knee

name: Azel
message: 「Not harming you is... the Lord's will...? Impossible...」

name: Bylous
message: 「I am the Demon Lord's enemy.」
Azel's eyes went wide.

name: Azel
message: 「Are you saying my will was not in accordance with the Lord's?!」
Bylous didn't answer, turning to walk toward the park exit.

name: Azel
message: 「I am God's agent! The apostle of Re-Crea! I was chosen by the Lord! I am!」
The departing figure stopped and looked back.

name: Bylous
message: 「Then stay with me until the very end. All the way to the brink of ruin.」
